name: AITER-enabled MLA layer inference on MI300X with matrix absorption
notes: Measured on MI300X with AITER v0.1.4, ROCm v6.4.0, PyTorch v2.6.0. MLA with matrix absorption delivers up to 2x faster inference vs non-AITER. Speedup increases with context length. Batch sizes 1-512, context 1024-8192.
